# `ecfr_snapshot_sections`

**Dated eCFR snapshot content nodes**

One native content node within a retained dated eCFR response, linked to its snapshot. Node text, heading, XML position and attributes remain source observations.

**Coverage.** Sampled. Native content nodes in selected retained dated snapshots. Missing source periods and unselected titles remain outside the evidenced scope. *(measured 2026-10-10)*

- **Parquet file:** `ecfr_snapshot_sections.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `snapshot_id` | `VARCHAR` | Reader identity of the dated source selection and original body digest. |
| `xml_position` | `VARCHAR` | XML positional path of this node within the source snapshot. |
| `kind` | `VARCHAR` | Native source node kind. |
| `native_number` | `VARCHAR` | Source-stated node number. |
| `part` | `VARCHAR` | Source-stated parent part. |
| `heading` | `VARCHAR` | Source-stated heading, retaining absence separately from empty text. |
| `text` | `VARCHAR` | Native node text within its recorded source context. |
| `attributes_json` | `VARCHAR` | Native XML attributes retained as JSON. |
| `byte_start` | `BIGINT` | Source reader byte position, when available. |
